Peter Barrett, one of the company's founders, remembered him as "completely unflappable," and said that after a while nobody was giving him directions at all, because he was just building what he wanted to build. Bruce Leak, who hired him, said: "He had boundless energy." So yeah, nobody handed Elon the big problem, he just went looking for it, at night, after a full day at another job. This is who Elon Musk is 💙

I see how some people can watch flashy robot demos on the timeline and think with a shiver that the robot apocalypse is around the corner, but reality check:

There is no robot in the world that can change the batteries in a jack-o-lantern.

If you have a robot friendly door handle it might be able to walk outside, pick it up, and carry it back inside. The robot could open the drawer with your batteries in it, but then things get tough.

Opening the package of AA batteries?
Extracting a precision screwdriver from its case?
Unscrewing four tiny screws that require a hard press and twist?
Popping batteries out of the case?

Yes, you could build and train a specialist robot to do that today, but there is a very long way to go to replace the full range of human capabilities. Near term doomer scenarios should stop at “secretly controlling humanity” instead of “wiping humanity out” 😀

When @Starlink helped save a man’s life during emergency surgery in rural Zimbabwe.

A young man suffered severe burns to his leg after falling into a cooking fire during a seizure. His parents spent hours helping him reach a remote hospital in Chisizya.

Dr. Mike Jeans needed to perform an emergency operation he had never done before. Using Starlink, he called a colleague in South Africa, who guided him through the surgery.

The operation succeeded. The patient was transferred by ambulance to a larger hospital. MATTER, the charity involved, reported that he survived and was recovering.

Starlink connected a doctor to lifesaving medical guidance when his patient needed it most.

This is why Starlink matters. A working connection can help save a life. This lifesaving technology should be available in every part of the world.

The Central Bank of Jordan says it has finished building and switching on a satellite internet gateway supplied by Starlink. It sits at the Aqaba Digital Hub and is run through the financial sector's cyber incident response team. The bank says it will keep the banking system online if the cables that connect Jordan to the internet fail because of natural disasters, major outages, cyberattacks, war or sabotage. Banks have been told to finish setting up so they can switch over when needed.

NASA Artemis 负责人解释了 SpaceX 如何以“惊人”的速度在飞行之间重建星际飞船，他称其在标准行业历史上是“不可想象的”

杰里米·帕森斯（Artemis 负责人）：“正如你们很多人所知，SpaceX 在 9 月底用 Starship Flight 14 发射了他们的第一次轨道飞行，当时使用的是他们的 3 号 Starship。它比之前的版本进行了重要升级，我的意思是，总的来说，这是一次相当惊人的飞行。”

“SpaceX 和 NASA 团队已经对这次飞行进行了数据审查。他们在 15 号航班方面取得了巨大进展，我认为这绝对是令人惊叹的，因为它很可能会返回发射场并捕获助推器和星际飞船。两架飞行器都已经过低温验证。正在努力改进以吸取 14 号航班的经验教训。”

“如你所知，SpaceX 采用测试、学习、改进的方法。因此，我们看到了大量的硬件、大量的快速变化以及绝对惊人的生产速度。”

“举个例子，SpaceX 确定了多个猛禽发动机在助推返回和着陆时重新点火失败的根本原因。他们对 13 号和 14 号航班实施了多项快速修复，以提高实现更多测试目标的机会，然后当他们开始飞行改进版猛禽时，他们已经对 15 号航班进行了永久性硬件改进。”

“在这个时间轴上发生的这些变化在标准行业历史上是不可想象的。”

quoted.text_zh: 剧本将是这样的：1）赢回众议院和参议院，并希望在 2028 年赢得总统职位； （2）接纳华盛顿特区和波多黎各为不需要修宪的州，获得4个新的参议院席位，巩固控制权； (3) 打包最高法院，只需要修改1869年的《司法法》，而不是宪法修正案； （4）取消选举团制度，这是违宪的，但如果法庭被操纵，发现了“漏洞”，就不会这样做； （5）让顺从的移民涌入这个国家，淹没当地人，并无限期地掌权。
